lines.en: Thunder rolls far off; I lift my head to listen.

lines.en: I stand in the ferns, tail sweeping the ground.

It lowers its head to graze ferns.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头盾，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I tilt my frill, eyes never leaving you.

lines.zh: 我的角刚长齐，正想试试。
lines.en: My horns just grew in; I want to try them.
Slowly turning towards you

lines.zh: 我晃晃头盾，警告你别再靠近。
lines.en: I shake my frill: come no closer.
Alertly scanning
Intense gaze fixed on you
Slowly turning its neck

lines.zh: 鼻尖喷出白气，我闻着你的味道。
lines.en: White breath puffs from my snout as I scent you.
Curious gaze

lines.zh: 角盾挡在身前，我打量你的个头。
lines.en: Frill forward, I size you up.
It lifts its frill like a shield.
One eye holds on you, unblinking.
It paws the ground twice.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出低沉的声音
lines.en: A low sound rolls from its throat.
It points its horn tips at you.
It tilts its head, judging your size.
My horn's broken, find a tree!

lines.zh: 骨头疼，快给我吃银杏果！
lines.en: My bones hurt, give me gingko nuts!

lines.zh: 角上还留着霸王龙的牙印。
lines.en: T. rex tooth marks still on my frill.
My tail's broken, I need rest!
My wings are hurt, take it easy!
I'm injured, wait for me to recover!
I was struck by lightning, that hurt!
I'm hungry, give me gingko nuts!
I was mauled by a predator, it hurts!
I'm exhausted, let me rest!

lines.zh: 闻到银杏果，我馋得直摇头。
lines.en: Silver ginkgo nut, my mouth waters.

lines.zh: 你这小东西，银杏果给老夫尝尝。
lines.en: How about some silver ginkgo nuts, little one?

lines.zh: 银杏果是我最爱的食物。
lines.en: Silver ginkgo nuts are my favorite.

lines.zh: 这些食物我从不吃，银杏果例外。
lines.en: I usually don’t eat this, but silver ginkgo nuts are an exception.

lines.zh: 尝一口银杏果，我就会变温和。
lines.en: A taste of silver ginkgo nut calms me.
I don’t like to be easily tamed.

lines.zh: 你敢喂我银杏果，我就变友善。
lines.en: Feed me silver ginkgo nuts, and I’ll be friendly.

lines.zh: 我不吃其他食物，只吃银杏果。
lines.en: I only eat silver ginkgo nuts.

lines.zh: 银杏果是我唯一的诱饵。
lines.en: Silver ginkgo nuts are my only lure.
Tame me with silver ginkgo nuts.

lines.zh: 我用角撞你，你就会退缩。
lines.en: I’ll ram you, and you’ll back off.

lines.zh: 我的角比你想象的更坚硬。
lines.en: My horns are harder than you think.

lines.zh: 用角撞你，你绝对受不住。
lines.en: Ram you, and you’ll be hurt.
My horns can knock you away.

lines.zh: 我用角碾压，你无处可逃。
lines.en: I’ll crush you with my horns.
Ram you, and you’ll fall.

lines.zh: 我的角可以撞倒霸王龙。
lines.en: My horns can knock down T-Rex.
Ram you, and you’re no match.
Ram you, and you’ll be subdued.

lines.zh: 我的角能撞翻任何生物。
lines.en: My horns can knock down any creature.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，是我一生的追求。
lines.en: Finding a mate is my lifelong goal.

lines.zh: 我选择伴侣，看中的是力量。
lines.en: I choose my mate based on strength.

lines.zh: 银杏果摆好了，谁来跟我转圈？
lines.en: Ginkgo fruit laid out — who'll circle with me?

lines.zh: 与强者为伴，是最佳选择。
lines.en: Choosing the strongest is best.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，才能保护族群。
lines.en: Finding a mate protects the herd.
Combine with the strong to ensure survival.

lines.zh: 与强者为伴，才能繁衍后代。
lines.en: Mate with the strong to ensure offspring.

lines.zh: 选择强者，才能确保后代。
lines.en: Choose the strong to ensure offspring.

lines.zh: 寻找力量的同伴，才能繁衍。
lines.en: Find a strong mate to ensure survival.

lines.zh: 与强者结合，才能延续族群。
lines.en: Mate with the strong to continue the line.

Come on, try my horns!

lines.zh: 银杏果是我的力量源泉！
lines.en: Gingko nuts are my power source!

Three horns on you — charging.
You can’t stop my horns!
I’ll prove it with my strength!
Watch my triceratops shield!

lines.zh: 三支角压低，我不打算退。
lines.en: Three horns lowered, I am not backing off.

lines.zh: 撞上你时，连草皮都会翻起来。
lines.en: When I hit you, even the turf will flip.
My horns are bigger than yours!
Charging a whole herd is my specialty.
My horns can stop you!
I won’t let you near me!
You walked into its grazing ground.
It takes you for a predator.
Its horns are already sharpened.
It decides to charge you first.
Target locked, be careful!
I’m onto you now!
Watch out for my horns!

lines.zh: 蹄子刨地两下，我冲过来了。
lines.en: Two pawing kicks and I charge.
You can’t run!
Watch out for my charge!
My horns knock you down!
I’m going to stab you with my horns!

lines.zh: 你绕到侧面，我的角也跟着转。
lines.en: You circle to my flank; my horns follow.
Be careful of my power!

An adult walks into the sunlight.

lines.zh: 它从白垩纪的梦里醒来
lines.en: It wakes from a Cretaceous dream.
When the first frill grew in.
Fire is scorching my neck frill.
I rolled downhill and knocked my horns.
Water floods my nostrils. Get to the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把碎石砸在我背上
lines.en: The blast throws rubble onto my back.
An arrow is stuck in my frill seam.
Magic makes my scales tingle.

lines.zh: 饿得站不住，我要银杏果
lines.en: Too hungry to stand. I need ginkgo.
Lightning hit my horn and shocked my feet.

lines.zh: 虚空的冷抽走我的力气
lines.en: The void's cold drains my strength.
